prompts.name: lblt_cover2
prompts.prompt: The bottom part of this TV studio photo is solid black and empty. Fill that black area so the whole image is one seamless photograph: continue the studio downward - the anchor desk in front of the woman with her laptop, the lower part of her beige satin blouse, the monitor stand legs and the dark studio floor, lit like the rest of the scene. Keep the top part exactly unchanged (same woman, same face and expression, same chart with its Korean text). Photorealistic, no new text, logos, captions or watermarks.
